_comment: Expansion 3 part D.2: level 4 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

aura_of_life.name: Aura of Life
aura_of_life.text: An aura of life reaches 30 feet from you (concentration): you and your friends within it resist necrotic damage, and a friend lying at 0 hit points starts its turn with 1 hit point again. The book's guard on maximum hit points is not in the game.

aura_of_purity.name: Aura of Purity
aura_of_purity.text: A clean aura reaches 30 feet from you (concentration): you and your friends within it resist poison and have advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralysed, poisoned or stunned.

banishment.name: Banishment
banishment.text: A foe within 30 feet must make a Charisma save or be sent to a harmless pocket of space (concentration, a minute), helpless and out of the fight. Fiends, fey, celestials, elementals and aberrations do not come back. One more foe for each higher slot.

blight.name: Blight
blight.text: Life drains out of a creature within 30 feet: 8d8 necrotic, Constitution save for half. Each higher slot adds 1d8. A plant that fails automatically and the withering of a plain tree are not in the game.

charm_monster.name: Charm Monster
charm_monster.text: A foe within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save, with advantage while you fight it. On a failure it is charmed and will not strike you, until you or your friends hurt it. One more creature for each higher slot.

compulsion.name: Compulsion
compulsion.text: Every foe within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed (concentration), and at once spends its move going straight away from you. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. You do not choose the direction: it is always away.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.text: Minds unravel in a 10-foot radius up to 90 feet away (concentration): a foe failing a Wisdom save has no bonus action or reaction, and each turn rolls a d10: wander off, do nothing, lash out at a neighbour, or act freely. It saves again each turn.

conjure_minor_elementals.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
conjure_minor_elementals.text: Spirits of fire flit around you (concentration, ten minutes): every attack you make deals 2d8 more fire damage. Each higher slot adds 2d8. The book lets you pick acid, cold or lightning and limits it to foes within 15 feet.

conjure_woodland_beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
conjure_woodland_beings.text: Nature spirits flit around you for 10 feet (concentration): enemies who come into them or end a turn there make a Wisdom save or take 5d8 force, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d8. The free Disengage is not in the game.

dimension_door.name: Dimension Door
dimension_door.text: You step through space to any open spot you can see within 500 feet. Taking a friend along, and the 4d6 force if the spot is taken, are not in the game.

dominate_beast.name: Dominate Beast
dominate_beast.text: A beast within 50 feet makes a Wisdom save (advantage while you fight it) or is yours for a minute (concentration): it fights on your side. Whenever it is hurt it saves again, and a success frees it. Longer durations from higher slots are not in the game.

evards_black_tentacles.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
evards_black_tentacles.text: Black tentacles fill a 20-foot square up to 90 feet away (concentration): hard going, and anyone caught or entering must make a Strength save or take 5d6 bludgeoning and be held, hurt again at the start of each of its turns.

fire_shield.name: Fire Shield
fire_shield.text: Wispy flames wreathe you for ten minutes: you resist cold, and whoever hits you in melee takes 2d8 fire. Only the warm shield is in the game, not the chill one.

fount_of_moonlight.name: Fount of Moonlight
fount_of_moonlight.text: A cool light wreathes you (concentration, ten minutes): you resist radiant damage and your melee hits deal 2d6 more radiant. The reaction that blinds whoever hurts you is not in the game.

freedom_of_movement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedom_of_movement.text: For an hour a creature you touch cannot be paralysed or restrained, by magic or by any other means. One more creature for each higher slot. The book's protection from slowing, the free swim and the escape from bonds are not in the game.

grasping_vine.name: Grasping Vine

again.name: Grasping Vine: another lash
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action lashes out again: a melee spell attack for 4d8 bludgeoning that drags the foe to the vine and holds it.

grasping_vine.text: A bonus action: a vine lashes a foe within 60 feet (concentration). A melee spell attack does 4d8 bludgeoning, drags the foe up to 50 feet to you and grapples it (Huge or smaller). Each turn a bonus action lashes again. More grapples from higher slots are not in the game.

greater_invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater_invisibility.text: A creature you touch vanishes for a minute (concentration), and stays hidden even when it attacks or casts: blows at it have disadvantage, and its own have advantage.

otilukes_resilient_sphere.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
otilukes_resilient_sphere.text: A shimmering sphere closes around a foe within 30 feet unless it makes a Dexterity save (concentration, a minute): nothing passes in or out, so it is out of the fight where it stands. Any size is caught here, not only Large or smaller.

phantasmal_killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
phantasmal_killer.text: A foe within 120 feet sees its worst fear (concentration). Wisdom save: 4d10 psychic, half on a success. On a failure it takes the damage again at the end of each of its turns until it saves. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

staggering_smite.name: Staggering Smite
staggering_smite.text: Readied on the blow: the next melee hit deals 4d6 more psychic, and the foe makes a Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

vitriolic_sphere.name: Vitriolic Sphere
vitriolic_sphere.text: A ball of acid explodes in a 20-foot radius up to 150 feet away: 10d4 acid, Dexterity save for half. A foe that fails takes 5d4 more at the end of its next turn. Each higher slot adds 2d4 to the first.

wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall_of_fire.text: A wall of fire rises from your side in a line you choose, 60 feet long (concentration). Whoever stands in it takes 5d8 fire, Dexterity save for half, and again on entering or ending a turn there. It blocks sight. Each higher slot adds 1d8. The ring wall is not in the game.
